Subject: Proposed SOW reallocation + fee question

Jonas,

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. We reviewed Exhibit B and identified two deliverables we want to reassign between phases: Move 'Model Validation Suite' from Phase 2 into Phase 1 (so our QA team can start earlier), and split 'Integration Support' hours across Phase 1 and Phase 3 instead of all in Phase 2.

Can you confirm whether that change will require a formal change order or if the revised Exhibit B and a short confirmation email suffice? Also, the finance team is asking how the monthly fee will be prorated given the shifted deliverable schedule.

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed SOW reallocation + fee question

Emma — thanks, this is helpful. Short answers up front:

- We treat scope changes that adjust deliverable allocation as a change order to the Order Form / Exhibit B (standard procurement practice for auditability).
- We can propose a minimal change order that only updates Exhibit B (no price uplift if scope and hours remain equivalent).
- Prorating: if a deliverable moves earlier such that billing milestones shift months, we will map fees to milestone dates and pro-rate the month where the milestone crosses billing cycles.

I'll loop in Legal to prepare a concise change order (Exhibit B replacement + signatory block) and Ops to produce a prorate draft. Laura, Marissa — can you take the attached spreadsheet and generate a redlined Exhibit B and an estimated prorate memo for Nova? Target EOW 12/18.

Thanks,
Jonas
VP, Commercial
Redwood Inference

Marissa — please review acceptance language (we kept the same test pass criteria but added an explicit acceptance gate for early validation). Also flag any billing triggers that might create a material cashflow change for Nova.

Quick read-through done. Main observations:
- No net increase in hours, so commercial price stays the same.
- Because Model Validation Suite moves from month 3 to month 1, Nova will see an earlier milestone-triggered invoice; we recommend a one-time credit so their cash flow doesn't spike in month 1. Proposed credit equals the portion of the milestone payment that would have been invoiced in month 3.
- Legal: we added a signatory line for change order and preserved the MSA fallback language.

I'll prepare a short cover email to Nova explaining the one-time credit and include redline and clean Exhibit B for signature. Jonas — ok to propose the credit in the amount of $28,750?
